character_cdo.camera_attach_parent_source: C++ Source/LastBell/Character/LBCharacter.cpp line 51: FirstPersonCamera->SetupAttachment(GetCapsuleComponent()), SetRelativeLocation(0,0,64); LBCameraFeelComponent sets eye above feet = StandingHalfHeight + the camera's BaseRelativeLocation.Z (= capsule half height + 64 when standing) plus head bob / landing dip, converted to a capsule-relative Z

spawn.camera_uses: the FirstPersonCamera component (capsule centre + 64); BaseEyeHeight (64) is relative to the capsule centre too (APawn::GetPawnViewLocation, used by AI perception), so both give floor + half height + 64

roof.method: upward traces from floor+110 at Y -100/0/+100 (20 cm steps, 7 bisections at each end); only greybox/collision geometry and blocking helper volumes (stepped through) can be seen

axle.wheel_hint: TWA_BellRope bounds centre x 12550, y 1835: the rope hangs from the wheel rim at the east end (headstock bounds x max 12554)
axle.wheel_disc_evidence: headstock extents X 264.0, Z 264.5 (equal: the wheel disc lies in the XZ plane, diameter about 264) and Y 348.0 (the beam through it)
axle.reasoning: The headstock (rotation [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]) is 264 (X) by 348 (Y) by 264 (Z): the X and Z extents match (the wheel disc, in the XZ plane) and the beam through it is the long horizontal axis, world Y, so the axle runs along Y; the rope hangs from the wheel rim at the end of that beam. The bell component's rotation is [0.0, 0.0, 0.0], so its local Y axis is the axle. Rotation about local Y is Pitch (about X it would be Roll), hence the bell swings in Pitch.

notes.label: Note_Gatehouse
notes.body_text: I came up the cliff path at dusk and heard it before I saw the tower. One toll, slow, from a bell the villagers swear has no rope and no clapper. They say it rings only for the one who is meant to hear it. I wrote this by the gate, and I am no longer sure I will leave by it.

They say it rings only for the one who is meant to hear it. I wrote this by the gate, and I am no longer sure I will leave by it.

notes.label: Note_Nave
notes.body_text: Brother Anselm says the three candles must burn before the altar will answer. One in the nave, one in the sacristy, one upon the choir dais. Light them in any order, but do not let them gutter. The flame keeps what lies beneath the floor from listening.

notes.label: Note_Sacristy
notes.body_text: Do not trust the mechanisms. There are three, and the old brothers say they keep it sleeping. I have read the ledger twice, and I think they do the opposite. Every wheel turned loosens something below. If you are reading this, you have already turned the first.

notes.body_text: Entered in the book of the crypt: the Warden was brought below in chains, and the door was sealed with the wax of the last bell. He was a man once, or so the first abbot wrote. We left him the dark and a lamp to pace by. The chains were made to hold him for a season, not for ever.

notes.label: Note_Cloister
notes.body_text: The great bell rang again tonight, and no hand was on the rope. Brother Anselm says the four small bells beside the tower door still answer to the old order of the dead, and that the order is cut in the stone above them. Strike them as the dead recall, and the tower will open. I will not go up. God forgive whoever does.

findings: MCP DOES have Sequencer authoring: `animation_toolset.toolsets.sequencer.SequencerTools` (create_level_sequence, add_spawnable_from_class, create_camera, add_track_to_binding, add_section, set_camera_cut_binding, add_marked_frame, add_event_trigger_section ...) plus the keyframing, Control Rig, import/export, conditions, custom-binding and outliner toolsets, and `UMGToolSet` (no widget-animation tool). There is no general editor Python (only the sandboxed `ProgrammaticToolset.execute_tool_script`). Plan section 8 (S1 headless Python spike) can be replaced or shortened by an MCP spike; the lead should decide.
Capsule radius is **34**, not 42 (half height 88). The clearance bar of 102 cm is computed as asked; with the real radius the equivalent bar is 94.

`BaseEyeHeight` (64) is measured from the capsule centre, so the spawn eye is floor + 88 + 64.0 = **152.79**, not floor + BaseEyeHeight (64.79). Plan 3.1 'floor Z + BaseEyeHeight' for `Cam_Intro` pose B must read floor + 152 (floor under the PlayerStart is 0.79, not 0).
The PlayerStart (-2800, 0, 100) is **outside** the `CP_Approach` Trigger box in XY (box (-2750, -200, -8) .. (-2650, 200, 192)); the box starts 50 cm east of the spawn.

The bell mesh component `Mesh` is **already Movable** in the placed instance (plan section 5 says P17-5b must set it); it is the actor's root component, collision `QueryAndPhysics / BlockAllDynamic`, so its relative transform is the world transform.

Pivot: the bell component origin is z 2860.0 (the bell's top); the headstock axle is at about z 2877.8 (headstock bounds centre), i.e. ~18.0 cm above the component origin. A pitch applied to the component rotates about its own origin, not about the axle; `FBellPendulum` should account for the offset (or the pivot should be moved to the axle).

`Bell_Beam` (cube, scale 0.8x2x1 at z 3350) and `Bell_Chain` (cube 10x10x550 at z 3025) are invisible BlockAll greybox cubes; `TWA_Headstock` and `TWA_BellRope` are NoCollision art, `TWA_BellFrame` blocks. None of them moves when the bell mesh component swings.

Blocking helper volumes: Trig_TowerTop, Trig_CourtyardEntered, Trig_CryptEntered, Trig_CloisterEntered, Kill_Pit. `trace_world` stops at the BP_TagTrigger boxes (and `Kill_Pit`) although `Trig_CourtyardEntered` reads collision QueryOnly / OverlapOnlyPawn; a plain trace through the gate passage or around the tower top meets a trigger volume. The survey steps through them (using the recorded box-like solids flush with them); in-game it matters only for traces on a channel those boxes block (the channel `trace_world` uses is not documented).

Glimpse rule: G1 none; G2 none on the chosen mark M1 (plan 3.2: a missing glimpse becomes sound-only). From the belfry floor the lower stair flights are hidden by the belfry floor and the core; only flight F11 (its upper half) and the top slab are visible, and every visible sample has a drop of at most 4.4 cm (drop = eye Z minus sample Z + 245). No sample qualifies for G1 or G2 on any mark.

Walk path from `Stair_F11_00`: reading A (top step) 993.7 cm = 9.0 s at 110 cm/s, reading B (slab arrival, the plan's nominal CINE_StairTop) 1118.4 cm = 10.2 s. The plan's nominal arrival 64.0 (55.0 + 9.0 s) matches A; with B the figure arrives at about 65.2 s. Lane to the stop point: A BLOCKED (rail / flight / bell frame), B CLEAR.
M2 fails the clearance bar: 79.7 cm to TWA_S3_N, Tw_N (the north wall, Y 2460, is 80 cm away).

The six notes (section 7) against the intro cards of plan 3.1: no hard contradiction. Points for the lead: (1) `Note_Gatehouse` is a traveller who 'came up the cliff path at dusk' and wrote 'by the gate', while Intro_1 says no one has climbed to the monastery for forty years, so that note has to be older than forty years (it carries no date); (2) the same note says the bell has 'no rope and no clapper' but the belfry has `TWA_BellRope` hanging from the wheel (art, NoCollision); (3) `Note_Cloister` ('The great bell rang again tonight, and no hand was on the rope') describes an earlier ringing (the brothers were still there), so it fits Intro_2 (silent since they vanished) and Intro_3 (rung again tonight);
